title: Replace selected installed skill units explicitly
actor: A project user replacing conflicting destination skills
goal: Replace only the selected candidate units with the verified complete version while preserving unrelated work and retained originals.
context: Some candidate skill destinations already exist, possibly with local changes or obsolete files.
trigger: The user decides whether to replace the reported existing units.
preconditions: The requested target and candidate can be verified and the intended replacement scope is identifiable.

interaction.action: Requests installation and reviews the reported existing-unit conflicts.
Identifies every discovered candidate conflict and explains the complete-unit replacement scope and loss of local modifications within it.
Explicitly authorizes force replacement of the selected candidate units.
Reports actual replaced and installed units, retained originals, and any safety or partial-failure limits.

expected_outcome: Explicitly selected whole units are replaced from verified content without overlay leftovers or unrelated replacement, and the user receives an honest account of retained originals and effects.

alternatives.condition: A candidate destination exists with identical bytes or is empty.
alternatives.outcome: It is still reported as a default conflict and requires the same explicit replacement choice.

alternatives.condition: Some units are absent while others conflict.
alternatives.outcome: Default installation changes none of them; an applicable force request can replace conflicting units and install absent ones.

failures.condition: Force was not authorized for existing candidate units.
failures.outcome: The full conflict set is reported and no candidate unit is changed.

failures.condition: A link, unsafe ancestor, changed preflight basis, unsupported safety primitive, or newly appearing destination is detected.
failures.outcome: The operation stops even under force; no additional replacement is silently authorized.

failures.condition: Replacement or verification fails after some effects.
failures.outcome: Completed, failed, detached, partial, and untouched scope and retained-original locations are reported; retry requires fresh verification/preflight and explicit replacement choice.
